verses.sanskrit:
लोमश उवाच।
              समुद्रं स समासाद्य वारुणिर्भगवानृषिः। उवाच सहितान्देवानृषींश्चैव समागतान्॥१॥
verses.english: Lomasha said: Coming to the ocean, the exalted Rishi, the son of Varuna thus spoke to the assembled celestials and the Rishis, who had come with him.

verses.sanskrit: अहं लोकहितार्थं वै पिबामि वरुणालयम्। भवद्भिर्यद‌नुष्ठेयं तच्छीघ्रं संविधीयताम्॥२॥
verses.english: "For the good of the world, I shall drink up this abode of Varuna (ocean). You should at once make the preparations which devolves upon you to make."

verses.sanskrit: पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य मन्त्रयित्वा पुनः पुनः। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे सागरस्याभिपूरणम्॥२॥
verses.english: "For the good of the world, I shall drink up this abode of Varuna (ocean). You should at once make the preparations which devolves upon you to make."

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मैत्रावरुणिरच्युतः। समुद्रमपिबत्क्रुद्धः सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥३॥
verses.english: Having spoken these few words, the undeteriorating son of Mitra and Varuna began in wrath to drink up the ocean in the sight of all the world.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नस्त्राता विधाता च लोकानां लोकभावन। त्वत्प्रसादात्समुच्छेदं न गच्छेत्सामरं जगत्॥५॥
verses.english: (They said) “O protector of the world you our Saviour and you are the creator of the world. Through your favour the universe with the immortals may be saved from extermination."

verses.sanskrit: स पूज्यमानस्त्रिद‌शैर्महात्मा गन्धर्वतूर्येषु नदत्सु सर्वशः। दिव्यैश्च पुष्पैरवकीर्यमाणो महार्णवं निःसलिलं चकार॥६॥
verses.english: Being thus worshipped by the celestials while the musical instruments of the Gandharvas played all around and celestials blossoms were showered on him, that highsouled (Rishi) made the great ocean waterless.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा कृतं निःसलिलं महार्णवं सुराः समस्ताः परमप्रहृष्टाः। प्रगृह्य दिव्यानि वरायुधानि तान्दानवाञ्जघ्नुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥७॥
verses.english: Seeing the great ocean made waterless, all the celestials were filled with joy; and taking up various celestials weapons they began to kill the Danayas with courageous hearts.

verses.sanskrit: ते वध्यमानास्त्रिदशैर्महात्माभिर्महाबलैर्वेगिभिरुन्नदद्भिः। न सेहिरे वेगवतां महात्मनां वेगं तदा धारयितुं दिवौकसाम्॥८॥
verses.english: Being attacked by the high-souled and greatly powerful, swift-coursing and loudly roaring celestials, they (the Danavas) were unable to withstand the on set of those swift and courageous dwellers of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: ते वध्यमानास्त्रिदशैर्दानवा भीमनिःस्वनाः। चक्रुः सुतुमुलं युद्धं मुहूर्तमिव भारत॥९॥
verses.english: O descendant of the Bharata, those loudly roaring Danavas, being thus attacked by the celestials, fought a great battle for a moment.

verses.sanskrit: ते पूर्वं तपसा दग्धा मुनिभिर्भावितात्मभिः। यतमानाः परं शक्त्या त्रिदशैर्विनिषूदिताः॥१०॥
verses.english: But they had been already burnt by the force of the penances of pure-souled Rishis (whom they had killed). Therefore though they tried their utmost, they were all killed by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit: ते हेमनिष्काभरणाः कुण्डलाङ्गदधारिणः। निहता बह्वशोभन्त पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥११॥
verses.english: Adorned as they were with golden ornaments and earrings, they (the Danavas), when killed, looked as beautiful as the Palasha tree when full of blossoms.

verses.sanskrit: हतशेषास्ततः केचित्कालेया मनुजोत्तम। विदार्य वसुधां देवीं पातालतलमास्थिताः॥१२॥
verses.english: O best of men, the remnant of those Kalkeyas that were not killed, took shelter in the nether regions after having rent the goddess Earth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रसादान्महाबाहो लोकैः प्राप्तं महत्सुखम्। त्वत्तेजसा च निहताः कालेयाः क्रूरविक्रमाः॥१४॥
verses.english: “O mighty-armed one, through your favour the world has obtained great happiness. The greatly powerful Kalkeyas are all destroyed by your might.

verses.sanskrit: पूरयस्व महाबाहो समुद्रं लोकभावन। यत्त्वया सलिलं पीतं तदस्मिन्पुनरुत्सृज॥१५॥
verses.english: O mighty-armed one and O saviour of the world, fill up the Ocean (again). Give up the water drunk by you."
Seeing the Danavas destroyed, the celestials gratified that foremost of Rishis (Agastya) with various speeches; and they then thus spoke,

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच भगवान्मुनिपुङ्गवः। जीर्णं तद्धि मया तोयमुपायोऽन्यः प्रचिन्त्यताम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Seeing the Danavas destroyed, the celestials gratified that foremost of Rishis (Agastya) with various speeches; and they then thus spoke,

verses.sanskrit: पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य भवद्भिर्यत्नमास्थितैः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः॥१७॥
verses.english: Having been thus addressed, the exalted great Rishi thus replied. “The water has been digested by me. Think of other means, if you are willing to fill up the ocean with water." Having heard those words of that high-souled grcat Rishi, the assembled celestials, were all filled with wonder and also with sorrow, Bidding farewell to one another and bowing to the great Rishi.

verses.sanskrit: विस्मिताश्च विषण्णाच बभूवुः सहिताः सुराः। परस्परमनुज्ञाप्य प्रणम्य मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥१८॥
प्रजाः सर्वा महाराज विप्रजग्मुर्यथागतम्। त्रिदशा विष्णुना सार्थमुपजग्मुः पितामहम्॥१९॥
verses.english: All creatures went away whence they came. The celestials with Vishnu went to the Grandsire (Brahma).
